summary_en: Occupant apps, access, bookings, services and building IoT.
summary_fr: Applications occupants, accès, réservations, services et IoT du bâtiment.

tools.name: Aareon
tools.positioning: The European ERP of social and institutional housing — where the tenant file, the rent and the works order live together.
tools.description: Aareon provides enterprise property management software for social landlords, institutional owners and large managers across Europe, with a French organisation serving bailleurs sociaux: tenant and lease management, rent and charge accounting, allocation processes, maintenance and tenant self-service portals.
tools.real_estate_use: French social housing operates under rules no commercial system covers: regulated rents, the allocation commission, the surface and resource ceilings, the supplément de loyer. Aareon's French deployments encode those processes, which is why the sector runs on specialised ERPs rather than on general property management platforms.
features: Tenant, lease and allocation management for regulated housing
Rent and charge accounting with regulatory rules
Maintenance and works order management
Tenant self-service portal and digital services
Asset and patrimony management
Regulatory and management reporting

use_cases.job: Run regulated allocation and rent processes for a social housing portfolio
Hold asset, lease and works data for a large institutional patrimony in one ERP

tools.name: Equiem
tools.positioning: Tenant experience with an editorial team behind it — the content is the product, not just the app shell.
tools.description: Equiem provides a tenant app and portal for office and mixed-use buildings covering communications, bookings, access, retail offers and events, differentiated by managed content services that produce building communications on the landlord's behalf.
tools.real_estate_use: Most tenant apps fail from emptiness: nobody at the landlord has time to post anything, so occupants stop opening it. Equiem sells the editorial capacity alongside the platform, which is why it is chosen by landlords who want engagement without hiring a community manager per building.
features: Tenant app and web portal for a building or campus
Managed content and communications services
Amenity, room and event booking
Retail and service offers with local vendors
Access control integration and mobile credentials
Engagement and utilisation analytics

use_cases.job: Keep a tenant app genuinely used without hiring a community manager per building
Communicate building notices and events to occupants directly

tools.name: essensys
tools.positioning: The infrastructure layer under flex space — network, access and billing for buildings running many operators.
tools.description: essensys provides software and on-site technology for flexible workspace: operations and billing platform, plus network infrastructure that segments and provisions connectivity per tenant, and access control across multi-tenant buildings.
tools.real_estate_use: A landlord converting floors to flex has a problem no coworking app solves: every occupier needs its own secure network segment, provisioned in hours rather than weeks, and metered. essensys sits at that layer, which is why it is bought by landlords and large operators rather than by single spaces.
features: Per-tenant network provisioning and segmentation
Automated billing for space, services and consumption
Access control across multi-tenant buildings
Operations platform for flexible workspace portfolios
Real-time service usage metering
Landlord-grade reporting across operators

use_cases.job: Turn floors into flex space with secure per-occupier networks provisioned in hours
Meter and bill services consumed by multiple operators in one building

tools.name: HqO
tools.positioning: The landlord's app for the people who work in the building — and the measurement of whether they come in.
tools.description: HqO is a workplace experience platform for office landlords and occupiers: a tenant-facing app for access, amenities, bookings, events and communications, plus an analytics layer measuring how a building is actually used.
tools.real_estate_use: Since hybrid work, an office landlord's asset value depends on whether tenants renew, and renewal depends on whether employees turn up. HqO gives the landlord a direct channel to occupants rather than only to the tenant's facilities contact, and produces the utilisation data used in renewal conversations and in amenity investment decisions.
features: Tenant experience app with building access and mobile credentials
Amenity, room and service booking
Building communications, events and community features
Workplace utilisation analytics and benchmarking
Tenant satisfaction measurement
Integrations with access control and building systems

use_cases.job: Measure building utilisation to support a renewal or amenity investment case
Access the building, book a room and see what is on today from one app

tools.name: SmartRent
tools.positioning: Smart apartment hardware and software sold to the operator, not to the resident.
tools.description: SmartRent provides smart home hardware and a management platform for rental housing: smart locks, thermostats, leak sensors, self-guided tour access, community access control and parking, managed centrally by the operator across a portfolio.
tools.real_estate_use: Three operational cases drive the purchase. Self-guided tours let a prospect visit a vacant unit without staff. Smart locks remove the key handover and the lock change at turnover. Leak sensors catch water damage — the largest avoidable insurance claim in multifamily — before it reaches the unit below.
features: Smart locks with credential management at turnover
Self-guided tour access for prospective residents
Thermostat control on vacant units
Leak detection and water shut-off alerting
Community access control and parking management
Portfolio-wide device management and alerts

use_cases.job: Offer self-guided tours of vacant units without on-site staff
Reduce water damage claims and turnover costs across a portfolio

tools.name: SpinalCom
tools.positioning: A building operating system — the layer that makes twenty proprietary building systems queryable as one digital twin.
tools.description: SpinalCom publishes a building operating system that aggregates data from heterogeneous building systems — HVAC, lighting, access, metering, BIM models — into a semantic digital twin, exposed through APIs so applications can be built on top rather than integrated one by one.
tools.real_estate_use: A smart building project usually stalls on the same wall: every subsystem speaks a different protocol and belongs to a different contractor. Placing an operating system between the equipment and the applications means the tenant app, the energy dashboard and the maintenance tool all read the same model of the building, and replacing a supplier does not break everything above it.
features: Aggregation of heterogeneous building systems and protocols
Semantic digital twin linked to the BIM model
Open APIs for third-party applications
Real-time supervision and equipment monitoring
Data historisation for energy and operations analytics
Vendor-independent architecture

use_cases.job: Read every building subsystem through one model instead of twenty interfaces
Build tenant and energy applications on a twin that outlives a supplier change

tools.name: Ubigreen
tools.positioning: Energy and space usage measured together — because an empty floor that is still heated is both problems at once.
tools.description: Ubigreen provides French building operators with energy performance monitoring, regulatory declaration support, and workplace occupancy measurement, combining consumption data with presence and space-use data in one platform.
tools.real_estate_use: Since hybrid work, the two questions arrived together: how much energy does this building use, and how much of it is actually occupied. Measuring both allows the decision that follows — consolidating occupancy onto fewer floors and shutting down the rest, which moves consumption far more than any equipment upgrade.
features: Energy consumption monitoring across multi-site portfolios
Décret tertiaire and OPERAT declaration support
Workplace occupancy and space utilisation measurement
Comfort and indoor environment monitoring
Alerting on consumption drift and equipment faults
Reporting for occupants and management

use_cases.job: Consolidate occupancy onto fewer floors and shut down the energy on the rest
Declare regulated consumption and track the effect of measures taken

tools.name: VTS
tools.positioning: The leasing pipeline for office landlords — every tour, proposal and lease in one view, plus a demand index nobody else has.
tools.description: VTS is a leasing and asset management platform for commercial landlords: deal pipeline, space availability, tenant and broker activity, portfolio reporting, and the VTS Market and Activate products covering marketing and tenant experience. Its VTS Office Demand Index derives leading indicators from platform activity.
tools.real_estate_use: Office leasing runs on a pipeline that traditionally lived in a leasing director's spreadsheet. VTS makes it institutional: every requirement, tour and proposal is tracked, so an asset manager can forecast occupancy and compare a proposed deal against portfolio standards. Because a large share of US office space transacts on the platform, aggregated tour activity becomes a market signal weeks ahead of signed-lease data.
features: Leasing deal pipeline with tours, proposals and approvals
Space availability and stacking plans
Portfolio occupancy and lease expiry reporting
VTS Market for online marketing of available space
VTS Activate tenant experience application
Office Demand Index from aggregated platform activity

use_cases.job: Forecast occupancy from a real leasing pipeline rather than from a spreadsheet
Track every requirement and proposal on a landlord's portfolio in one system

tools.name: Wattsense
tools.positioning: Plug-in connectivity for buildings too small to justify a full BMS integration project.
tools.description: Wattsense provides a hardware and cloud solution that connects a building's existing equipment — boilers, HVAC, meters, controllers — across multiple protocols and exposes the data and control points through a single cloud API, without a bespoke integration project.
tools.real_estate_use: Most of a commercial portfolio is not headquarters buildings. Mid-sized assets have some automation, no standardisation, and no budget for a systems integrator per site. Wattsense targets exactly that middle: a box on site, protocols handled, data and control available remotely — which is what makes portfolio-wide energy management feasible below the flagship tier.
features: Multi-protocol connectivity to existing building equipment
Cloud API for data collection and remote control
Deployment without a bespoke integration project
Remote monitoring and alerting across sites
Data normalisation across heterogeneous equipment
Partner integrations with energy and facility platforms

use_cases.job: Connect mid-sized buildings to remote monitoring without an integration project each
Standardise data collection across a portfolio of heterogeneous equipment

tools.name: Witco
tools.positioning: The occupant app for French office buildings — services, bookings, access and building communication in one place.
tools.description: Witco provides a white-label mobile application for office buildings and workplaces: room and desk booking, access and badge integration, service requests, on-site retail and concierge services, events, communication and occupant feedback.
tools.real_estate_use: Landlords and corporate occupiers use it as the single interface between the building and the people inside it. Practically, it consolidates what used to be five channels — an email for building notices, a booking tool, a paper ticket for maintenance, a WhatsApp group for events — into one app whose usage data also indicates how the building is really used.
features: White-label occupant mobile app for a building or campus
Room, desk and parking booking
Access control and mobile badge integration
Service requests routed to facilities or providers
Building communication, news and events
Occupant satisfaction measurement and usage analytics

use_cases.job: Give employees one app for booking, access, services and building news
Offer occupants a service layer that supports the rent and the renewal
